title: 2026 Xiaomi YU7 Max
headline: Fully Electric SUV
summary: A dual-motor, all-wheel-drive electric SUV with 691 HP, a 101.7 kWh CATL battery and up to 760 km of range (CLTC).

specifications.label: Driving Range
specifications.value: Up to 760 km (CLTC) on a full charge

specifications.label: Charging
specifications.value: 10%–80% in approximately 12 minutes with compatible ultra-fast DC charging

specifications.label: Suspension
specifications.value: Adaptive air suspension for improved ride comfort

specifications.label: Seats
specifications.value: Heated, ventilated and massage-function front seats

availability: Available at 5Points Electric Technology Limited for immediate pickup and delivery nationwide.
